behavior: fingerprintStrings(values) returns 'sha256:' + first 32 hex of sha256(JSON.stringify([...values].sort())); pure, no I/O, input not mutated
fingerprint string is exactly 39 chars: 'sha256:' prefix + 32 lowercase hex chars
same values in different order give the same fingerprint (sorted copy before hashing)
fingerprintStrings(["a","b"]) = sha256:0473ef2dc0d324ab659d3580c1134e9d; fingerprintStrings([]) = sha256:4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5
fingerprintRecords maps each record to `${id}:${status||""}`, sorts, and delegates to fingerprintStrings; updatedAt in the parameter type is IGNORED
run-registry.ts:149, observability.ts:75 and evidence-reasoning.ts:773 keep byte-identical PRIVATE copies of the fingerprint algorithm; outputs must match the util exactly
state-explosion/helpers.ts re-exports fingerprintStrings/fingerprintRecords from util/fingerprint; state-explosion.ts re-exports fingerprintStrings again

fingerprints truncate to 32 hex; content digests elsewhere (ledger.ts:107, telemetry-attestation.ts:254, reclamation/hash.ts:19, contract-migration.ts:102, coordinator/util.ts:19, execution-backend/util.ts:14) use FULL 64 hex under the same 'sha256:' prefix; never unify
src/types.ts re-exports all 25 files under src/types/ in a fixed order; importers use "./types"; validation.ts and orchestrator/collaboration-operations.ts also import domain files directly
every export in src/types/ is a type or interface; the compiled modules carry zero runtime values
OneWayData<T> poisons any function-bearing type to never; unknown passes as opaque data; a union with a violating member collapses IsOneWayData to boolean and fails

boundary.ts must keep the exact source strings AssertTrue<IsOneWayData<ExecutionResultEnvelope>>, AssertTrue<IsOneWayData<ResultEnvelope>>, AssertTrue<IsOneWayData<UsageRecord>>, and types.ts must keep 'export * from "./types/boundary"'; a callable added to any weld type breaks npm run build
persisted record interfaces pin schemaVersion as the LITERAL type 1 (~92 occurrences across src/types/)
src/validation.ts structurally re-validates parsed JSON against types/candidate, types/state-node, types/worker: validate*() throws on mismatch, tryValidate*() returns null, never fabricates
TaskStatus = pending|running|completed|failed; TaskKind = agent|artifact; PhaseStatus = pending|running|completed
LoopStage = interpret|act|observe|adjust|checkpoint
FindingClassification = real|conditional|non-issue|unknown; Severity = P0|P1|P2|P3|none

StateNodeKind has exactly 28 values: input,task,dispatch,result,candidate,verifier,commit,blackboard,blackboard-topic,blackboard-message,blackboard-context,blackboard-artifact,blackboard-snapshot,coordinator-decision,topology-run,topology-phase,multi-agent-run,agent-role,agent-group,agent-membership,agent-fanout,agent-fanin,report,schedule,trigger,loop-control,error
StateNodeStatus = pending|running|completed|failed|blocked|verified|rejected|committed
EvidenceConfidence = ungrounded|grounded|resolvable|verified; 'verified' is never auto-assigned, only host attestation sets it
ResultEnvelope = { summary: string, findings: Finding[], evidence: string[] } — schema-identical across all backends

RunPaths names the run dir layout: runDir,state,report,tasksDir,resultsDir,dispatchesDir,artifactsDir,commitsDir,stateNodesDir,feedbackDir + optional auditDir,workersDir,candidatesDir,multiAgentDir,blackboardDir,topologiesDir,graphSnapshotPath
TrustAuditSource = cw-validated|host-attested|operator-recorded|runtime-derived; TrustAuditDecision = allowed|denied|accepted|rejected|recorded|validated|failed
TrustAuditEvent optionally chains via prevEventHash/eventHash (eventHash = sha256 of canonical event sans eventHash); pre-chain events verify as 'unchained', never broken
NodeSnapshotFreshness = valid|stale|absent; snapshot sourceFingerprint is over the RAW node (id:status:updatedAt + artifact/evidence ids+paths), never normalized
diff sections are exactly status|inputs|outputs|artifacts|evidence|errors|links|metadata with change added|removed|changed|same
PipelineRunnerStatus = advanced|failed|idle; stage timeout auto-fails with code 'stage-timeout'; failurePolicy.autoAdvance defaults false (fail closed)
PipelineContract.commitMessageTemplate is PARKED spec-debt: declared in v0.1.68, no consumer; must not be implemented without a real caller

ErrorFeedbackStatus = open|tasked|resolved|rejected; severity = critical|high|medium|low|info; classification has 10 values ending in 'unknown'; source = state-node|pipeline-runner|verifier|contract|cli|manual
SandboxPolicyMode = none|allowlist|any; ResolvedSandboxPolicy carries enforcement {enforcedByCW, hostRequired}

SandboxResolutionContext.customProfiles + WorkflowRun.customSandboxProfiles store custom profile DEFINITIONS keyed by logical id so a worker boundary can re-resolve after scope-snapshot loss against the worker context

SandboxDimension = read|write|command|network|env; SandboxDimensionSupport = enforce|attest|unsupported; SandboxAttestationStatus = enforced|attested|refused; non-empty unenforceable means the backend refused (fail closed)

BackendReadiness = ready|unavailable|unverified; a backend that is not ready MUST refuse to run; BackendKind = local|delegating; BackendLocality = local|remote; BackendSelectionSource = flag|env|task|default
ExecutionStatus = completed|failed|refused; ExecutionResultEnvelope = {schemaVersion:1,status,result,evidence,provenance} and result/evidence are byte-stable across backends
agent delegation argv template substitutes {{manifest}},{{input}},{{result}},{{workerDir}},{{model}},{{prompt}} into DISCRETE argv elements, never a shell string
AgentDelegationConfig resolves flags > env (CW_AGENT_COMMAND / CW_AGENT_ENDPOINT / CW_AGENT_MODEL) > $CW_HOME/agent-config.json; fails closed when neither command nor endpoint configured
requireAttestedTelemetry (opt-in, default off) resolves flags > env CW_REQUIRE_ATTESTED_TELEMETRY > file; when true a hop whose telemetry is not 'attested' is parked before accept-side mutation
AgentDelegationProvenance.model / DriveStep.reportedModel is SOLELY the agent-reported model id, or the literal 'unreported'; never backfilled from CW_AGENT_MODEL
AgentDelegationConfig.source = flag|env|file|auto|none (provenance for the show verb)
DriveStepAction = dispatch|fulfill|accept|commit|park|blocked|complete; DriveStepStatus = ok|parked|blocked|failed|complete; DriveResult.status = complete|parked|blocked|in-progress
drive payloads carry no now-derived numeric field; only ISO timestamps may be now-derived; counts come from state
QuickstartResult.resumedFrom/.bundle/.remote are present ONLY on their paths (resume/--bundle+complete/remote source) so default output stays byte-identical
QuickstartCheckStatus = ok|warn|blocked; QuickstartCheckResult.mode = 'check' and is zero-write
TrustKeySource = bundle|argument|environment|none; ReportBundleVerification.trustLevel = signed|unsigned; ReportBundleResult.ok=false means do not ship

MultiAgentLifecycleStatus = planned|forming|running|collecting|verifying|completed|failed|cancelled; membership adds assigned|reported|verified; fanin = planned|collecting|blocked|ready|verifying|completed|failed
policy operations include the write set (message,context,artifact,snapshot,topic,coordinator-decision) plus template forms candidate.register|score|select and judge.verdict|rationale|panel-decision
MultiAgentState = {schemaVersion:1, runs, roles, groups, memberships, fanouts, fanins} — the persisted multi-agent container on a run
MultiAgentTopologyId is an open string; the built-ins are exactly map-reduce, debate, judge-panel (policy), registerTopology() is the seam for more
TopologyRunStatus = planned|running|blocked|ready|completed|failed; phaseProgress statuses = pending|running|completed|blocked
WorkerMultiAgentMetadata is declared in types/topology.ts (not multi-agent.ts) and imported from there by worker/dispatch code
BlackboardRecordStatus = active|open|resolved|superseded|conflicting|rejected|archived; message visibility = public|group|role|private
CoordinatorDecisionKind = context-update|artifact-index|candidate-synthesis|conflict-resolution|fanin-readiness|message-moderation; outcome = accepted|rejected|superseded|conflicting|ready|blocked
Blackboard.paths names root,index,messages,topicsDir,contextsDir,artifactsDir,snapshotsDir,decisionsDir — the on-disk blackboard layout keys
WorkerIsolationStatus = allocated|running|completed|failed|rejected|verified|orphaned; timeoutMs>0 elapsed lets reclaimOrphans() mark 'orphaned' (default 0 = no timeout)
WorkerScope persists as worker.json (durable scope) and WorkerManifest as manifest.json (worker-facing projection) in the worker dir
WorkerScope.usage / RunTask.usage absent means 'unreported', never zero; recorded verbatim on intake, never synthesized by CW
CandidateStatus = registered|scored|selected|rejected|verified|failed; CandidateKind = worker-output|result|artifact|manual|release; verdict = pass|warn|fail; tieBreaker = createdAt|candidateId
AcceptanceRationale.commitGateResult = passed|blocked|checkpoint

gates = fanin|candidate-score|selection|verifier|commit; status adds fail-closed 'unexplained'; rationale status = explained|unexplained|not-applicable; a missing rationale is 'unexplained', never fabricated

WorkflowRun (schemaVersion literal 1) is the persisted .cw/runs/<id>/state.json shape with optional blocks nodes,contracts,feedback,audit,workers,sandboxProfiles,customSandboxProfiles,candidates,candidateSelections,multiAgent,blackboard,topologies,collaboration
RunTask.schema present ⇒ the agent's cw:result payload is validated on intake and a mismatch throws, parking the hop (fail closed); absent ⇒ no schema enforcement
RunExport keeps the legacy v0.1.74 'artifacts' array for old archives; modern content is in 'files' with role run-file|artifact|audit|telemetry; trust block carries ONLY the ed25519 PUBLIC key PEM
ScheduleKind = loop|cron|reminder; ScheduleStatus = active|paused|completed|expired; ScheduleRunStatus = due|started|completed|failed|skipped
ScheduleStore = {schemaVersion:1, tasks, history}; RoutineTriggerStore = {schemaVersion:1, triggers, events, nextTriggerSeq?}
RoutineTriggerStore.nextTriggerSeq is a monotonic, delete-proof id sequence: it never decrements on trigger delete, so a later create cannot reuse a live id
RoutineTriggerKind = api|github; RoutineTriggerEvent carries payloadPath and optional dedupKey for idempotent event processing
RunLifecycleState = queued|running|blocked|completed|failed|archived|reclaimed; archived/reclaimed are OVERLAYS, never derived from source; derivedLifecycle preserves the source-derived state

RunTier = live|archived|reclaimed; RunCapability = re-runnable|verify-only|re-runnable-by-reconstruction; RunCapabilityReason is the closed set live-full|archived-full|scratch-only-reclaimed|inputs-and-expectdigest-retained|snapshot-reclaimed-no-reconstruction
RunRecordFreshness = valid|stale|missing (missing = source vanished, fail closed); RunRegistryFreshness = valid|stale|absent
queue entry status = pending|ready|draining|drained|cancelled|leased|parked; lower priority drains first, ties break by enqueuedAt then id; parkedReason cleared only by sched reset
SchedulingPolicy backoff = baseMs * factor^(attempts-1) capped at capMs, NO jitter; maxConcurrent is a hard ceiling never exceeded; skip reasons = concurrency-ceiling|parked|backoff|leased|terminal
RunRegistryIndex persists under .cw/registry/ (repo scope) or $CW_HOME/registry/ (home scope); derived and rebuildable, never authoritative
RunRegistryPolicy reclaim knobs all default to reclaim NOTHING (reclaimAfterArchiveDays 0 = disabled); reclamation is opt-in and dry-run-first
ReclaimKind = scratch|reconstructable-snapshot|candidate|reference-free-blackboard; any UNCLASSIFIED path defaults to RETAINED (fail closed)
ReclaimRefusalCode = not-archived|within-retention|non-terminal|open-feedback|unreadable|already-reclaimed|skeleton-incomplete
ReclaimVerifyCode = not-reclaimed|skeleton-incomplete|tombstone-digest-mismatch|tombstone-chain-broken|reconstruction-digest-mismatch|ineligible-when-reclaimed|reclaim-proof-deleted

tombstone chain: genesis prevTombstoneHash = sha256 of the sealed skeleton; tombstoneHash recomputed from freed-manifest + skeleton + prevTombstoneHash; gc verify never trusts the stored hash; freed paths are RELATIVE to the run dir with pre-deletion sha256
ReclaimedOverlay is the per-run append-only reclaimed.json (allow-listed, never freed); the registry derives tier/capability from it
WorkbenchPanelStatus = present|absent; a panel embeds ONE capability's --json payload VERBATIM under data; absent carries an honest error, never a fabricated view
WorkbenchServeDescriptor pins host to the literal '127.0.0.1' and readOnly to literal true; every WorkbenchRoute is GET; non-localhost Host headers are rejected

the fixed panel tree: graph{operator,multiAgent,compact,criticalPath}, blackboard{coordinator,digest,graph}, worker{summary}, candidate{summary,reasoning}, audit{summary,multiAgent,policy,judge}, metrics{report}, collaboration{review,comments}
UsageAttestationSource is ONLY host-attested|operator-recorded — cw-validated/runtime-derived are deliberately excluded because CW never measures usage
TelemetryAttestationStatus = attested|unattested|absent; unattested is surfaced loudly, never silently trusted

telemetry ledger records hash-chain via prevHash/recordHash; genesis prevHash = sha256("cw-telemetry-ledger:"+runId); recordHash = sha256(canonical record sans recordHash); telemetry.json is append-only, never rewritten
RateMetric with zero total ⇒ state 'n/a' with count/rate null, never 0% or 100%; numerator and denominator always present
DurationMetric for in-flight items has wallClockMs null and inFlight true — never a now-based guess; all durations come from RECORDED timestamps

CostState = attested|estimated|unpriced|unreported; attested only from attested usage x recorded policy; attested and estimated are NEVER conflated; ModelPrice is USD per 1e6 tokens with exact model-id match
MetricsReport.generatedAt is the ONLY now-derived field; sourceFingerprint + freshness (valid|stale|absent) make the report deterministic over a fixed snapshot
ActorAttestation = host-attested|operator-recorded|unattributed; ActorKind includes the literal stand-in 'unattributed' for absent identity — never fabricated; CW records, never authenticates
CollaborationTargetKind = run|task|candidate|selection|commit|node; ApprovalDecision = approve|reject; timeline kinds = approval|comment|handoff|policy
approvals/comments/handoffs are append-only; a correction is a NEW record linked via supersedes, never an in-place edit; current owner is DERIVED from the latest handoff

ReviewStatus = approved|pending|rejected|blocked|unattributed; disqualification reasons = unattributed|unauthorized-role|self-approval|superseded; absent policy or requiredApprovals 0 = no gate (pre-v0.1.32 behavior)
workflow input type = string|number|boolean|path|json; phase mode = sequential|parallel (default sequential); subWorkflow bindResult = report|verdict-result (default report)

LoopUntil = {kind:'predicate',ref} (a NAMED registered pure predicate, never an inline closure) or {kind:'budget-target',target}; maxRounds is a hard fail-closed cap; limits.tokenBudget stays the absolute backstop
WorkflowLimits.tokenBudget IS enforced by the drive loop against recorded attested usage (the type comment saying enforcement 'lands later' is stale)
WorkflowAppSourceKind = app-directory|app-manifest|workflow-file; LoadedWorkflowApp carries app+source+legacy flag
WorkflowTaskResultCache.mode only 'read-write'; includeCompletedResults only 'previous-phases'
src/util/fingerprint.test.ts (node:test) compiles into dist/ but NO script runs it — test/run-all.js discovers only test/*-smoke.js; the behaviors it states must be pinned another way in a rebuild

state-explosion helpers: truncate() collapses whitespace and cuts to 80 chars with '...' (77+3); slug() replaces every char outside [a-zA-Z0-9._:-] with '-'; dominantStatus priority order is failed,blocked,rejected,conflicting,running,pending else first-or-completed
